shared_elements: incised/carved linear marks on a vertical stone surface
vertical parallel strokes forming a row
justification: A depicts a rich figural programme in relief — a row of crouching quadrupeds along the top, a horizontal band of hatched/fringed pattern, felines, a bird-headed creature, a boar or quadruped in profile, and a large long-necked bird — whereas B shows only sparse abstract incised lines, chevrons and short vertical strokes with no identifiable creature. The only correspondence is the generic presence of angular linear marks and roughly horizontal groupings of repeated strokes on an upright stone face, which any tradition could produce independently.
